title: Mountain Shrine
styleReference: Cinematic realism in three.js: golden-hour light, atmospheric perspective, volumetric fog and cloud, smooth drone moves. No cuts, no shake, no text, no logos.

scenes.title: Above the Clouds
scenes.logline: A drone glides slowly above a sea of white clouds at sunrise until a lush mountain peak rises through them with an ancient shrine on its summit, prayer flags lit gold.
scenes.props: sea of clouds; golden light rays; the shrine on the peak; prayer flags in the wind

scenes.title: The Valley
scenes.logline: The camera flies forward low through the valley over pine forests, a winding river, a wooden bridge and a lake reflecting the peaks, with waterfalls in the mist and birds gliding past.
scenes.props: pine forest; river; wooden bridge; lake reflections; waterfalls; birds; wildflowers in the wind

scenes.title: The Shrine
scenes.logline: The camera rises to the summit and slowly orbits the shrine, its carved roofs, glowing lanterns and wet stone steps against a panorama of misty Himalayan ranges.
scenes.props: tiered roofs; lanterns glowing; wet stone steps; prayer flags fluttering; a bell; fog drifting on the slopes

scenes.title: The Range
scenes.logline: The camera pulls slowly up and back until the whole range is revealed, the shrine small above the clouds and snow peaks glowing under the morning sun.
scenes.props: snow-capped peaks; golden horizon; clouds moving between the peaks; the shrine above the clouds
